question: Split the rail ledger's 0.875 pJ 'regulators' delivery loss plus logic in step with the rails' row into conduction loss (carries 1/V^2) and logic (does not), from the same minion-rail watts delivered at two rail voltages (E77-PLAN.md).

sampler.profile: no-PMIC-read (ettelem-e77: no GET_ASIC_VOLTAGE, no GET_MODULE_VOLTAGE, no statistics reset)

A.what: 600 MHz at about 516 mV: the static TDP level at 0 (the vmin-LUT floor pin, E72's write on this card)

heater.note: fp32 randn on 1,024 harts at 600 MHz, about 53-55 W on the board (E80's sustained 54.2 W)

B.what: 800 MHz at about 618 mV: the card's own governor at its own 65 W / 65 C

heater.note: fp32 randn on 768 harts, not 1,024: at 800 MHz the full card reads 82-85 W with single readings to 88.88 W (E83), which would trip the 85 W single-reading abort; 768 harts model to about 66-70 W

passes.order: B1 B2 | set TDP 0 | A1 A2 A3 SETTLE | restore TDP 65 | RETURN B3

settling.note: E77-PLAN's 12 s settling rung cannot be one launch under the lab's timeout 10; one 8 s launch of arm A's top rung gives the rails 4 s after the 4 s window (more than 6 tau)

return_burst.note: after the restore, one launch of arm B's top rung: the clock must step up to 800 MHz and the ring must hold a throttle-up line

gate.note: E60/E72's strict start (preheat to 59 C, launch at <= 58 C) with the rail ledger's S2 screen made a launch condition: >= 6 s since the last device process and the minion rail settled within 0.15 W between [t-5, t-3] and [t-2, t-0.3]. On this card the die falls from 59-60 C to 58 C within about 0.5 s of a heater ending (E72's own telemetry, 27 Oct) while the rails need about 10 s to settle, so the launch reading is expected at 55-58 C: a die that falls below 53 C before the rails settle is heated again (at most 3 times), after which the launch goes ahead at its reading, flagged below_floor; every launch reading is recorded and used in the leakage correction

cuts_card_min.note: card-minutes since the session took the lock; a pass is cut by whole rounds; the restore and the return burst are never cut; the runner's hard stop is 47 card-min and 18:55 PST

identity.anchor: E69's firmware revisions read, 27 Oct 2026 13:56:26 PDT (docs/reports/data/2026-10-27-e69-governor-knob/README.md:187)
identity.rule: the module uptime (DM_CMD_GET_MODULE_UPTIME, RAM) must exceed the minutes since the anchor: no service-processor reset since, so the identity read then still names the running image

safety.die_rule: the die mean (minshire[0]) on any reading
safety.high_rule: the die high-water latch (minshire[2], E69 A1: not a live reading)
safety.pin_rule: while the TDP is 0, any minion clock other than 600 MHz during a measurement launch
